description: Return a published comparison with columns, rows, summary and product sides. Unknown, retired or suppressed slugs return 404; missing cached products return 410. A non-canonical product order returns 200 with redirect_to naming the canonical slug. Cache-only.
name: lianex_vs_by_slug

PublicProduct.description: A cached product. Pass its outbound url unchanged to preserve affiliate tracking. Fields may be missing or null when unavailable.

availability.description: `InStock` or `OutOfStock`, rolled up across every stored lane.
availability.title: Availability

brand.description: The brand: the stored brand, else the listing's own Brand / Brand Name item specific — never a placeholder such as Unbranded.
brand.title: Brand

canonical_specs.description: The merged canonical spec sheet, when one could be derived.
canonical_specs.title: Canonical Specs

category_id.description: The marketplace category id we cached it under.
category_id.title: Category Id

condition.description: The stored condition label, when we recorded one.
condition.title: Condition

gtin.description: A GS1 barcode number (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits) from the listing's item specifics, included only when its check digit is valid.
gtin.title: Gtin

images.description: Additional gallery image URLs. May be empty.
images.title: Images

item_id.description: The marketplace's own id for this listing.
item_id.title: Item Id

marketplace.description: The STORED locale label (`EBAY_AU`), which is not the same string as `provider`.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

price.description: The price as a decimal STRING (`"1649.00"`), never a float — so it cannot lose cents to binary rounding on the way to you.
price.title: Price

return_terms.description: eBay listings only: whether returns are accepted, the return window in days, and who pays return postage. Null for other marketplaces or when unknown.

shipping.description: eBay listings only: the listing's cheapest shipping option as last seen — cost, currency, cost type and the delivery-estimate window. Null for other marketplaces or when unknown.

specifics.description: The listing's own item specifics, minus empty/placeholder values.
specifics.title: Specifics

title.description: The listing title as the marketplace states it.
title.title: Title

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 instant this listing was last re-checked.
updated_at.title: Updated At

url.description: The affiliate-wrapped outbound link. `null` when the marketplace is switched off.
url.title: Url

PublicProduct.title: PublicProduct

ReturnTerms.description: An eBay listing's return terms as last seen.

period_days.description: The return window in calendar days, when stated.
period_days.title: Period Days

return_postage_payer.description: Who pays return postage, when stated: BUYER or SELLER.
return_postage_payer.title: Return Postage Payer

ReturnTerms.title: ReturnTerms

ShippingTerms.description: An eBay listing's cheapest shipping option as last seen. Any field may be null when eBay did not state it.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 instant we read this delivery estimate; the estimate window is relative to it.
captured_at.title: Captured At

cost.description: Shipping cost as a decimal STRING; "0.00" means free.
cost.title: Cost

cost_type.description: eBay's shipping cost type, e.g. FIXED or CALCULATED.
cost_type.title: Cost Type

max_delivery.description: ISO-8601 instant: the latest estimated delivery date eBay quoted when we last saw the listing. An estimate, not a promise; it can be in the past.
max_delivery.title: Max Delivery

min_delivery.description: ISO-8601 instant: the earliest estimated delivery date eBay quoted when we last saw the listing. An estimate, not a promise; it can be in the past.
min_delivery.title: Min Delivery

ShippingTerms.title: ShippingTerms

SlugRedirect.description: The requested address has a current canonical slug. This JSON response uses status 200. Request the returned slug on the same endpoint.

redirect_to.description: The slug to follow. Not a URL — a slug.
redirect_to.title: Redirect To

SlugRedirect.title: SlugRedirect

VsComparison.description: The stored comparison content: product columns, comparison rows and summary.

columns.description: One column per compared product, in the frozen order.
columns.title: Columns

VsComparison.title: VsComparison

VsPage.description: A published head-to-head comparison of two or three cached products.

a.description: Alias for `sides[0]`, present only on a two-sided comparison.

b.description: Alias for `sides[1]`, present only on a two-sided comparison.

sides.description: The compared products, two or three of them.
sides.title: Sides

VsPage.title: VsPage
